stem_book: A small block of mass m slides along a smooth circular track of radius R as shown in the figure. If it starts from rest at P, what is the resultant force acting on it at Q? (Figure: P at height h = 5R above the bottom; Q is the point of the loop at height R where the track is vertical.)
work: v_Q² = 2g(5R − R) = 8gR ⇒ N = 8mg (horizontal), W = mg ⇒ F = √(64 + 1) mg = √65 mg
